name: Akoum
description: Akoum is one of Zendikar's seven continents, a red-aligned mountainous and volcanic land that hides the Eye of Ugin and the Eldrazi prison.

description_citations.text: "Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

summary.text: Akoum is one of Zendikar's seven continents, a red-aligned mountainous and volcanic land that hides the Eye of Ugin and the Eldrazi prison.

bio.text: Its history includes the Kargan tribes riding tamed dragons to victory over the kor and shattering the Akoum Skyclave.

"Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin met at a kor settlement there, and Ugin proposed imprisoning the three Eldrazi on Zendikar, which Nahiri accepted as their jailer.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: Cultists in Akoum, infected by Ulamog's influence, loosened the prison with their rituals, and Zhulodok awakened and razed the land before Nahiri repaired the hedron network.

bio.text: Nissa's spark ignited here when she faced the dark knot beneath its highest peak, and she planeswalked away.

citations.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

bio.text: In Battle for Zendikar, Jace was found by Zada in Akoum, who agreed to lead him to the Eye of Ugin.

citations.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.
"Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

bio.text: After the titans escaped, Nahiri found the Eye collapsed, and during the Skyclave story she studied a rising Skyclave on Akoum, where she and Nissa clashed.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Confronting the horror in the central peak of Akoum ignites Nissa's spark and she planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: the confrontation with the unspeakable horror ignited her spark

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The narrator and a climbing partner reach the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, which the narrator and their father had sought.
timeline.quote: You're standing on the largest field of floating ruins in Akoum, perhaps in all of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Monument to a Lost Age". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator finds the statue of the Eldrazi Monument among the ruins.
timeline.quote: you're convinced it's the most important thing you've ever seen

citation.text: "Monument to a Lost Age". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The climbing partner unclips his safety line and steps off the ruin to his death.
timeline.quote: you watch him step off the edge of the stone ruin

citation.text: "Monument to a Lost Age". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As the Makindi Empire crumbled, the Kargan tribes mastered Akoum's dragons and rode them to victory over the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor

citation.text: "Akoum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Eldrazi's return, kor gather around Glasspool and carve dwellings in the surrounding peaks.
timeline.quote: During the eldrazi's return, kor gathered in the area around Glasspool

citation.text: "Akoum", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zhulodok's passage carves the Windblast Gorge through Akoum's mountains.
timeline.quote: The gorge was originally carved by the passage of Zhulodok through Akoum's mountains.

citation.text: "Akoum", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon's tracking of Chandra dead-ends at a barren pass in Akoum.
timeline.quote: Chandra's trail dead-ended at a barren mountain pass in Akoum

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: A 150-foot-tall Eldrazi Titan appears on the horizon, draining color and life from the land.
timeline.quote: Mind-numbing, phantasmal, 150 feet tall ... a thing of madness.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: After Sea Gate, Anowon steals and kills indiscriminately in his hunt for the Eye of Ugin from his Akoum camp.
timeline.quote: From then on, he stole and killed indiscriminately to accomplish his goals.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "League of Anowon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar appears in Anowon's camp asking for guidance, and he agrees once he learns she also seeks the Eye.
timeline.quote: One day, the young planeswalker Chandra Nalaar appeared in his camp, asking for Anowon's guidance.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cultists in Akoum, infected by Ulamog's creative force, perform rituals that loosen the prison's bonds.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zhulodok awakens and razes the land; twelve cultists survive to become the first vampire bloodchiefs.
timeline.quote: but those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok, and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
timeline.quote: Even after Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa wins over the Moon Kraken Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death.
timeline.quote: Brinelin finally acquiesced to lead them safely through the crystal reefs.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cultists of Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison and broods devastate Zendikar.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "First awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Akoum cultists infected by Ulamog's influence perform rituals that loosen the Eldrazi prison.
timeline.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zhulodok emerges in the first awakening and razes the land, causing a famine; only twelve cultists survive to become the first vampire bloodchiefs.
timeline.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin kills a goblin to satisfy the Moon Kraken Brinelin; Nissa persuades Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death and the return of the brood, and he guides them through the reefs.
timeline.quote: Saddened by the loss and alarmed by the Eldrazi’s reappearance, Brinelin relents and guides them safely through the reefs.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anowon kills a scout who saved them, with Sorin's permission, shocking Nissa.
timeline.quote: only for Anowon to kill the man with Sorin’s permission, shocking Nissa.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nulls led by the vampires Biss and Shir ambush the group and take Nissa prisoner; her companions rescue her.
timeline.quote: That night, they are ambushed by an army of Nulls led by the two vampires Biss and Shir .

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa pushes Sorin to admit he is a vampire and the cause of the vanishings.
timeline.quote: he admits to being a vampire and the real reason so many around them have vanished during the trip.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Sorin regroup at a kor settlement in Akoum on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nahiri clutched the sword, the last trace of a now-dead world.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
timeline.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
timeline.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
timeline.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
timeline.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains he chose Zendikar because it has a protector, and asks for Nahiri's help rather than forcing her.
timeline.quote: No," said Ugin. "Because I also need your help.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows that her work is just beginning as she looks up at the imprisoned titans.
timeline.quote: My work is just beginning.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Zendikar breaks open; Nahiri senses the Eldrazi prison has been opened.
timeline.quote: the prison of the Eldrazi. It was open.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Near the Eye of Ugin, Nahiri finds a spiked stone building where the hedron network was disturbed and is furious.
timeline.quote: Even as she approached, she could tell that this was the point where the hedron network had been disturbed.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fights and kills vampires at the building with a glowing-hot sword.
timeline.quote: her glowing sword cut through cold flesh

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
timeline.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reshapes the statue into a new hedron, holding off more vampires and Eldrazi while she works alone.
timeline.quote: and brought the walls down on them, then returned to her work.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri completes the hedron and repairs the Eldrazi prison, driving the titans back into torpor.
timeline.quote: to link up the broken lines of the hedron network and repair the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa's vision shows a glowing version of herself facing the dark knot in a mountain before a bright light consumes all.
timeline.quote: a bright light blasted through the whole vision

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa practices her new powers while crossing the foothills of Akoum.
timeline.quote: Mazik encouraged Nissa to practice using her new powers.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The glowing stream vanishes and the Roil strikes, shaking the land violently.
timeline.quote: "The Roil! It's happening!"

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
timeline.quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Zendikar forms an elemental from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the dark knot.
timeline.quote: a fully formed elemental stepped out of the earth.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: At the ring of floating hedrons around the highest peak, Mazik falls ill and Nissa must go on alone.
timeline.quote: "I want you to go. I'll be okay. We'll be okay."

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa channels Zendikar's power in a massive blast at the mountain but it has no effect.
timeline.quote: it was as though her spell had done nothing.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The dark knot's madness shows Nissa the monster inside, and her spark ignites, hurling her from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: something inside her cracked, like an egg breaking open

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace climbs a cliff in Akoum in search of the Tuktuk goblins and hauls himself over the lip straight into an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: —and straight into an Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion fails against the Eldrazi, but Zada kills it with a blow from her pestle after a flash of blue light.
timeline.quote: just as a heavy club came down on its blank white head.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Zada reveals she ground up a hedron to fuel her spell and tells Jace that hedrons hold magic.
timeline.quote: A hedron holds magic for a thousand years,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Zada says Tuktuk is dead because she ate him, as goblins eat magic rocks to grow stronger.
timeline.quote: "I ate him," said Zada.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Zada agrees to lead Jace to the Eye of Ugin, noting the hedron network has no center now.
timeline.quote: But I suppose I'll show you the way, if you think it's important,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Zada leaves Jace at a cave entrance, warning that nobody goes in.
timeline.quote: Nobody goes in there. Bad magic. Certain death. Good luck!

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
timeline.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
timeline.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The kor tell Nahiri of the titans' rise and that some believe they are their old gods.
timeline.quote: three enormous monstrosities rose out of the Teeth of Akoum.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Bruse Tarl organizes a nomad resistance against the Eldrazi on Akoum.
timeline.quote: Bruse organized a resistance force of nomads.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri studies a rising Skyclave on Akoum, planning to use its secrets to change the world.
timeline.quote: With those secrets, she was going to change the world.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The Roil erupts and the ledge collapses, but Nahiri arrests her fall with lithomancy and builds a pillar.
timeline.quote: Her freefall slowed to a stop midair, until she was floating.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Nahiri on the pillar and Nahiri says she may have a solution to heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Something that will heal Zendikar.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa race up the Skyclave; Nahiri's stairs collapse and Nissa saves her with a vine.
timeline.quote: "Got you," Nissa murmured.

citation.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The Kargans, riding tamed dragons, shatter the Akoum Skyclave, ending Kor rule in the region.
timeline.quote: Their coordinated attacks ultimately succeeded in bringing down the Skyclave.

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's party activates Emeria's defenses and the Akoum fragments levitate again.
timeline.quote: its fragments began levitating once again

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims and barely escaped Ulamog.
timeline.quote: the two were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En split up; Jori En went back to warn Gideon.
timeline.quote: They then decided to split up

citation.text: "Jori En", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cultists in Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison with their rituals and temple; broods spring into existence and devastate Zendikar.
timeline.quote: eventually loosened the bonds of the Eldrazi prison

citation.text: "Rayami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Hedron Network weakens, Zhulodok is among the first Eldrazi to awaken at the head of Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: Zhulodok was among the first wave to awaken

citation.text: "Zhulodok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The fort is the safest haven in Akoum.
relations.quote: "Welcome to Fort Keff, the safest haven in Akoum."

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

relations.note: The Eye of Ugin lies in the mountains of Akoum.
relations.quote: a site high in the mountains near the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

relations.note: Founded the League of Anowon training camp in the Teeth of Akoum.
relations.quote: founded by Anowon high in the Teeth

citation.text: "Akoum", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: It once hovered above the mountainous continent of Akoum

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: is a forest on the continent of Akoum on Zendikar

citation.text: "Ora Ondar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: a perilous region of northern Akoum on the plane of Zendikar

citation.text: "Spikefields". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: is a treacherous mountain range in northern Akoum on the plane of Zendikar

citation.text: "Teeth of Akoum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A jagged granite region of Zendikar with gravitational anomalies and a field of floating ruins.

citation.text: "Monument to a Lost Age". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: The mountainous region of Zendikar where Fort Keff stands.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

pages_say.description: A rugged, volcanic highland of Zendikar where Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin meet and where the Eldrazi are finally held.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

pages_say.description: A region of Zendikar that shudders around the Eldrazi prison.

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

pages_say.description: The mountain region of Zendikar where the dark knot lies beneath its highest peak.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

pages_say.description: The region where the Eye of Ugin lies.

citation.text: "The Believers' Pilgrimage" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2015.

pages_say.description: A region of Zendikar of jagged volcanic rock and treacherous canyons, rearranged when the Eldrazi emerged.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

pages_say.description: A volcanic continent of Zendikar where Nahiri's tribe once wandered and the titans rose.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

pages_say.description: A continent of Zendikar overrun by Eldrazi.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
